# nobus_database_action (Resource)

Runs a one-shot Nobus database lifecycle action. Set action to `resume` to use the dedicated resume endpoint; other values use the general action endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nobus_database_action" "restart" {
  database_id   = nobus_database.example.id
  database_type = nobus_database.example.database_type
  action        = "restart"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String)
- `database_id` (String)
- `database_type` (String)

### Optional

- `availability_zone` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
